table_title: List the 41 UNESCO World Heritage Sites designated as Category=Mixed properties by UNESCO per UNESCO DataHub whc001 dataset. Universe predicate is UNESCO's authoritative Category=Mixed designation, equivalently expressible as the set-intersection of designated-cultural sites (category IN {'Cultural','Mixed'}) ∩ designated-natural sites (category IN {'Natural','Mixed'}) = 41 IDs. Tongariro National Park (id_no=421) is the one edge case where this designation is broader than `criteria_txt contains both cultural and natural codes` would yield — Tongariro's criteria_txt='(vii)(viii)' is both natural-only codes, yet UNESCO classifies it as Mixed (from its 1993 associative-cultural-landscape extension). For each Mixed site, give Country (sovereign country or comma-delim transboundary pair), UNESCO Region (closed 5-value: Africa / Arab States / Asia and the Pacific / Europe and North America / Latin America and the Caribbean), Year Inscribed (first inscription year per UNESCO date_inscribed field — secondary extension dates NOT staged per cycle-1 audit), and Criteria (parenthesized Roman-numeral codes verbatim from UNESCO criteria_txt field). Master-derived 41-row dump provided verbatim by cycle-1 audit from UNESCO DataHub whc001 dataset.
db_analog: WITH cultural_designated_sites AS (SELECT id_no FROM unesco_whc001 WHERE category IN ('Cultural','Mixed')), natural_designated_sites AS (SELECT id_no FROM unesco_whc001 WHERE category IN ('Natural','Mixed')), mixed_sites AS (SELECT id_no FROM cultural_designated_sites INTERSECT SELECT id_no FROM natural_designated_sites) SELECT s.name_en, s.states_names, s.region, s.date_inscribed, s.criteria_txt FROM unesco_whc001 s WHERE s.id_no IN (SELECT id_no FROM mixed_sites) AND s.category = 'Mixed' ORDER BY s.region ASC, s.date_inscribed ASC
temporal_note: UNESCO DataHub whc001 dataset (https://data.unesco.org/explore/dataset/whc001/), accessed via cycle-1 audit's master-derived 41-row dump on 2026-05-20. Universe is the closed canonical 41-entry set of UNESCO World Heritage Sites with Category=Mixed (sites that UNESCO designates as Mixed properties). Per cycle-1 post-staging audit's Tongariro edge: UNESCO's Category=Mixed designation is the authoritative universe predicate — note that whc001 row id_no=421 'Tongariro National Park' has category='Mixed' with criteria_txt='(vii)(viii)' (both natural-only Roman-numeral codes) and cultural_criteria=null in whc001, yet UNESCO still classifies it as Mixed (likely from associative cultural-landscape inscription where the cultural-criteria-list field is null but the Category=Mixed flag is authoritative). Thus the operational predicate is `Category=Mixed`, NOT `cultural_criteria IS NOT NULL AND natural_criteria IS NOT NULL` (the latter returns 40 rows excluding Tongariro). Tongariro is the only such edge in the 41-row universe. The set-operation INTERSECT semantic is preserved by the equivalent membership rule: `category IN ('Cultural','Mixed') INTERSECT category IN ('Natural','Mixed')` (returns 41 IDs). Per cycle-1 audit's required edits: (1) source registered as UNESCO DataHub whc001 (NOT Wikipedia — UNESCO's authoritative dataset carries category, criteria, year, location fields); (2) gt_construction = web_search_unesco (NEW analog to web_search_faostat + web_search_who pattern — 3rd pkdb_bench instance using web_search_* gt_construction for non-Wikipedia external sources); (3) universe count is 41 exact (NOT my preview's ~30-39 estimate); (4) UNESCO Region uses official labels with full 'and' phrasing: 'Africa' / 'Arab States' / 'Asia and the Pacific' (NOT 'Asia & Pacific') / 'Europe and North America' (NOT 'Europe & N. America') / 'Latin America and the Caribbean' (NOT 'Latin America & Caribbean'); (5) Year Inscribed = first inscription year from date_inscribed field (secondary extension dates NOT staged); (6) entity class = heritage-properties/world-heritage-sites (NEW bucket NOT events/world-heritage-sites per cycle-1 audit — these rows are heritage properties not events). Per-row cells: Site name rendered from UNESCO official designation per `name_en` field with one explicit orthographic normalization documented per cycle-1 post-staging audit: UNESCO DataHub's raw `name_en` for id_no=447 contains embedded `<U>r</U>` and `<U>t</U>` underline markup ('Ulu<U>r</U>u-Kata Tju<U>t</U>a National Park'); the staged Site cell renders these as Unicode underdot diacritic characters (Uluṟu-Kata Tjuṯa) which is the standard rendered form matching UNESCO's public Web view of the property. All other 40 Site cells are raw UNESCO-DataHub name_en verbatim, including full descriptive titles like 'The Ahwar of Southern Iraq: Refuge of Biodiversity and the Relict Landscape of the Mesopotamian Cities' and titles with UNESCO-native curly quotes like 'Chiribiquete National Park – “The Maloca of the Jaguar”' (curly U+201C/U+201D per UNESCO whc001, NOT ASCII straight quotes — corrected at cycle-2 post-staging audit fix); Country verbatim with full official sovereign-state names ('United Republic of Tanzania' / 'Democratic People's Republic of Korea' / 'Türkiye' for Turkey post-2022 rename / 'Viet Nam' with space per UNESCO / 'United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland' / 'United States of America') and comma-delim for transboundary sites (Maloti-Drakensberg 'Lesotho, South Africa'; Ohrid 'North Macedonia, Albania'; Pyrénées 'Spain, France'); UNESCO Region per official 5-value vocabulary; Year Inscribed integer year of first inscription; Criteria text with parenthesized Roman-numeral codes (e.g., '(i)(iii)(vii)(ix)' for Machu Picchu; '(iii)(viii)' for Willandra Lakes — shortest criteria list; '(i)(ii)(iii)(iv)(v)(vii)' for Mount Taishan — broadest cultural+natural mix). Set-operation framing: universe = designated-cultural sites ∩ designated-natural sites, equivalent to UNESCO's authoritative Category=Mixed designation per cycle-2 post-staging audit's predicate clarification (operational SQL: `category IN ('Cultural','Mixed') INTERSECT category IN ('Natural','Mixed')` = 41 IDs; Tongariro is the one edge included by Category=Mixed but excluded by `criteria_txt contains both kinds`). db_analog explicitly models the designated-cultural ∩ designated-natural intersection via INTERSECT clause with final Category=Mixed filter. temporal_sensitivity = low — UNESCO Mixed inscriptions are rare (~1 per year on average); 2025 Mount Kumgang is the most recent staged inscription.
_extraction_notes: Set_operation instance — closed canonical 41-entry UNESCO World Heritage Mixed sites universe constructed via set intersection equivalent to UNESCO's authoritative Category=Mixed designation (operational predicate: category IN ('Cultural','Mixed') INTERSECT category IN ('Natural','Mixed') = 41 IDs; equivalently filtering category='Mixed'). Single PK Site (41 closed values per UNESCO official designation). **Chips set_operation category** from 2 staged + 6 registered = 8/10 (under raised target 102 ceiling = gap-2 largest current gap) → 3 staged + 6 registered = 9/10 (gap-1; closer to saturation). **NEW `heritage-properties/*` entity bucket added** (pkdb_bench grows from 14 to 15 entity buckets — joining countries, subnational-regions, cities-and-capitals, people, physical-features, engineered-structures, events, artifacts, abstract-categories, taxonomic-entities, organizations, time-periods, agricultural-commodities, vehicles). NEW `heritage-properties/world-heritage-sites` fine-class. NEW Culture/Heritage subdomain (Culture family heavy at 10 but Heritage subdomain genuinely new). Source plan: 1 registered source (UNESCO DataHub whc001 dataset — universe + value role for all 5 cells per cycle-1 audit's required source-pivot from Wikipedia to UNESCO DataHub). claim_type = source_defined per cycle-1 audit; UNESCO authoritative dataset preserves source_defined cleanly. **gt_construction = web_search_unesco — 3rd pkdb_bench instance using web_search_* pattern** (after web_search_faostat + web_search_who). Cycle arc: 1 round of pre-staging design review (cycle-1 'Approve With Required Edits + Row Dump Provided' — UNESCO DataHub source pivot + 41-row exact count + official region labels + first-inscription-year convention + heritage-properties entity bucket choice). All cycle-1 edits applied at cycle-0 staging using audit's verbatim 41-row dump. 5-cell schema (Site PK + Country + UNESCO Region + Year Inscribed + Criteria) at 41 rows = 205 source-grounded cell values. Sort: UNESCO Region ASC alphabetic primary + Year Inscribed ASC secondary within region (mirror precedent decade_volcanoes_by_continent geographic-partition sort). Confidence gradient: very-LLM-knowable include Machu Picchu (Peru iconic Mixed site), Mount Athos (Greece monastic peninsula), Meteora (Greece elevated monasteries), Uluṟu-Kata Tjuṯa (Australia Aboriginal sacred site with diacritic preservation), Kakadu National Park (Australia), Tasmanian Wilderness; mid-difficulty include Mount Taishan / Mount Huangshan / Mount Wuyi (Chinese sacred mountains), Tikal National Park (Mayan), Cappadocia Göreme (Turkey); harder calibration include Pimachiowin Aki (Canada Anishinaabe-meaning 'the land that gives life' — 2018 inscription), Te Henua Enata (Marquesas Islands 2024 French Polynesia — very recent), Mount Kumgang (DPRK 2025 most-recent staged), Ennedi Massif (Chad 2016), Khangchendzonga (India 2016), exact criteria-code combinations like '(iii)(viii)' Willandra Lakes (shortest 2-criteria) vs '(i)(ii)(iii)(iv)(v)(vii)' Mount Taishan (broadest 6-criteria). Set_operation category-fit: per the category contract, the row universe is constructed via set arithmetic on source-defined sets — UNESCO designated-cultural sites (category IN {'Cultural','Mixed'}) ∩ designated-natural sites (category IN {'Natural','Mixed'}) = 41 Mixed-category IDs, equivalent to UNESCO's authoritative Category=Mixed designation per cycle-2 audit predicate clarification (Tongariro is the one edge case where the designated-cultural/designated-natural intersection captures it but the narrower `criteria_txt contains both kinds` would not). db_analog explicitly models this INTERSECT operation with final Category=Mixed filter. Mirror precedent `aau_big_ten_intersection_universities` (set intersection of AAU member set + Big Ten conference member set). Saturation impact: brings set_operation from 8 of 10 (raised target ceiling) to 9 of 10 = gap-1; one more set_operation instance would saturate the category.
